Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka has formed a responsible AI committee to develop the state's AI governance framework. The committee will create a comprehensive policy to ensure the ethical, safe, and transparent use of AI in government systems and public services. This framework aims to guide the deployment of AI across the state.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Karnataka showcases its AI prowess at India AI Impact Summit
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Karnataka showcased its artificial intelligence capabilities at the India AI Impact Summit. Karnataka's dedicated AI policies have contributed to its prominent position in the field.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Inside IAIRO, India’s ISRO for AI

Major AI Developments.summary: Violinist Dr. L Subramaniam believes that AI should enhance musical practice, rather than replacing it. Major AI Developments.title: AI is changing cyber threats. Recovery is becoming just as important as prevention

Major AI Developments.summary: ISRO-NRSC conducted a study that utilized satellite data and AI to map soil health in Andhra farmland. Major AI Developments.summary: OpenAI's Manara states that open-weight AI models are expanding options for startups. Major AI Developments.summary: Aramco Ventures has led a $9.5 million funding round in climate tech startup Mitti Labs, with participation from existing and new investors. Major AI Developments.title: Bengaluru India Nano 2026: AI breath test, nanotherapy offer new hope in fight against diabetes, cancer
Major AI Developments.summary: Researchers in Bengaluru, India, are developing an AI-powered breath test and nanotherapy to combat diabetes and cancer. The AI breath test and nanotherapy aim to provide more effective and non-invasive diagnostic and treatment options.

Major AI Developments.title: Karnataka eyes Anthropic tie-up to expand AI across public service

Major AI Developments.title: Peptris is using AI to find drug candidates to shorten the time it takes for laboratory validation
Major AI Developments.summary: Peptris, a Bengaluru-based company, is utilizing AI to identify potential drug candidates, aiming to reduce laboratory validation time. The company creates models that generate molecules and predict their behavior. Peptris has already licensed its lead candidate to a US developer, marking a significant milestone in its efforts.

Major AI Developments.title: Lemnisca builds software to predict how fermentation behaves at factory scale
Major AI Developments.summary: Lemnisca, a Bengaluru-based company, is developing AI software to model microbial fermentation. This software aims to predict how fermentation behaves at a factory scale, allowing manufacturers to identify potential issues before production. The goal is to enable seamless scaling of fermentation processes without discovering problems during production.

Major AI Developments.title: Former Swiggy, Zomato executives launch AI startup Profound with $1.5 Mn seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Bengaluru-based AI startup Profound has raised $1.5 million in a seed funding round to launch an AI-powered platform for professional networking and hiring. The startup was founded by Anuj Rathi and Prashant Parashar, former executives at Swiggy, Zomato, and other notable companies. The seed round saw participation from prominent angel investors, including Swiggy CEO Sriharsha Majety and former Zomato cofounder Pankaj Chaddah.

Major AI Developments.title: Zoppler Systems raises Rs 6.5 Cr led by Finvolve
Major AI Developments.summary: Zoppler Systems, a defence and dual use technology company, has raised Rs 6.5 crore in a funding round led by Finvolve. The funds will be used to accelerate product development, expand engineering capabilities, and scale deployments across defence and dual use sectors. Zoppler Systems develops indigenous RF sensing products and a decision and autonomy platform, and plans to strengthen field validation of its technologies with the new investment.

Major AI Developments.title: Outcome-first AI: redesigning enterprise service delivery at scale
Major AI Developments.summary: EY GDS Partner Tanu Garg challenged the common assumption that enterprise AI's primary role is automation, instead emphasizing its potential to redesign service delivery. Garg suggested that AI should focus on transforming existing processes rather than just making them faster. This approach, known as "outcome-first AI," aims to revolutionize enterprise service delivery at scale.

Major AI Developments.title: AI labs are proving why IT cos still matter: Infosys CEO Parekh
Major AI Developments.summary: Infosys CEO Salil Parekh stated that AI labs are demonstrating the continued relevance of IT companies. According to Parekh, the work being done in these labs highlights the importance of IT companies in the industry. This suggests that IT companies remain vital despite advancements in artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Revspot raises $4.8 Mn in Series A round co-led by Inflexor and Info Edge Ventures
Major AI Developments.summary: Revspot, a Bengaluru-based AI startup, has raised $4.8 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Inflexor Ventures and Info Edge Ventures. The round also saw participation from other investors, including Pentathlon Ventures and Silicon Road Ventures. The fresh capital will be used to strengthen its product and engineering teams and expand its AI-powered platform.

Major AI Developments.title: Building materials quick commerce startup Fixxly raises $5.5 Mn in seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Fixxly, a Bengaluru-based building materials quick commerce startup, has raised $5.5 million in a seed funding round from Accel, Fireside Ventures, and Lightspeed India Partners. The fresh capital will be used to strengthen its technology platform and scale operations ahead of its commercial launch on September 1. Fixxly plans to begin operations in Bengaluru before expanding to other cities with its AI-powered quick commerce platform for building materials.

Major AI Developments.title: Karnataka logs 72% student attendance via facial recognition app
Major AI Developments.summary: Karnataka has implemented a facial recognition app to track student attendance, resulting in a 72% attendance rate. Major AI Developments.title: Karnataka schools introduce AI as vocational subject in classes 9-10, instead of third language
Major AI Developments.summary: Karnataka schools are introducing Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a vocational subject for classes 9-10, replacing the traditional third language. Major AI Developments.title: Inside Myntra's AI playbook: Faster seller onboarding, smarter shopping, leaner operations
Major AI Developments.summary: Myntra has implemented AI tools to streamline its operations, including catalogue tools, fit visualizers, and the Maya chatbot. Major AI Developments.title: Instant medicine delivery startup Plazza raises $15 Mn led by Accel, Elevation and Nexus
Major AI Developments.summary: Plazza, a pharmacy-focused quick commerce startup, has raised $15 million in a Series A funding round led by Accel, Elevation Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners. Major AI Developments.title: Physical AI startup SwitchOn raises $8 Mn in pre-Series B round led by IvyCap
Major AI Developments.summary: SwitchOn, a Bengaluru-based Physical AI startup, has raised $8 million in a pre-Series B funding round led by IvyCap Ventures, with participation from SIG Tattva and Trifecta Capital. Major AI Developments.title: AI changing economics of software engineering: Wipro’s Premji
Major AI Developments.summary: Wipro's Premji stated that AI is transforming the economics of software engineering. AI is likely to increase efficiency and reduce costs in software engineering, according to Premji.

Major AI Developments.title: Elevation Capital leads $11.3 Mn Series A round in Reo.Dev
Major AI Developments.summary: Reo.Dev, an AI native GTM platform, has raised $11.3 million in a Series A funding round led by Elevation Capital, bringing its total funding to $15.3 million. Major AI Developments.title: Karnataka’s Bidadi Township project and the land acquisition dispute | Explained

Major AI Developments.summary: Google has launched a sovereign AI stack for India's regulated sectors, aiming to support the country's data localization requirements. Major AI Developments.summary: The growth of AI data centres is driving demand for industrial engineers, who are now commanding premium pay. AI Start-Up News.title: PedalStart leads pre-seed round in extracurricular learning platform UpKraft
AI Start-Up News.summary: UpKraft, an extracurricular learning platform, has raised Rs 1.6 crore in a pre-seed funding round led by PedalStart. The funds will be used to accelerate AI product development, expand its presence, and strengthen its technology platform and operations. The platform, co-founded in July 2025, aims to build teams across various functions, including product, technology, and sales.

AI Start-Up News.title: Dognosis is training dogs and AI to detect cancer from a breath sample
AI Start-Up News.summary: Dognosis, a Bengaluru startup, is developing a cancer detection method using dogs' sense of smell and AI. The approach combines brain-computer interfaces and AI to detect cancer from a breath sample. The goal is to create a cheap and non-invasive cancer screening method through this innovative technology.

AI Start-Up News.title: NeuralZome builds no-code AI that lets anyone train a robot without writing code
AI Start-Up News.summary: NeuralZome, a Bengaluru-based startup, has developed no-code AI that enables users to train robots without writing code. The company creates teachable AI agents for off-road robots, offering them as a service. NeuralZome has raised $2.4 million in a seed round led by 8X Ventures.

AI Start-Up News.title: H2LooP is building AI coding tools for the software hidden inside hardware
AI Start-Up News.summary: H2LooP, a Bengaluru startup, is developing AI coding tools for firmware and embedded systems in hardware. The company has created hardware-aware AI models to support this effort. H2LooP has raised $2 million to expand its technology into various sectors, including chips, cars, and defense.

AI Start-Up News.title: BluVenture leads Rs 100 Cr Series A round in E3 Electric.Ai
AI Start-Up News.summary: E3 Electric.Ai, a deep-tech electric mobility startup, has raised Rs 100 crore ($10.5 million) in a Series A funding round led by BluVenture Holdings. The funding will be used to accelerate product innovation and expand the company's market presence across India. The investment comes ahead of the commercial launch of E3 Electric.Ai's E3 TRION electric scooter.

AI Start-Up News.title: Piper Serica leads seed round in deep tech startup eNLife Research
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deep tech startup eNLife Research has raised Rs 6 crore in a seed funding round led by Piper Serica VC Fund. The funds will be used to develop its blood-based biomarker platform, expand its R&D team, and advance its diagnostic assay. eNLife Research aims to create affordable, AI-powered diagnostic platforms to detect neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI services to agentic AI: Nekko is building its next growth engine for business process transformation
AI Start-Up News.summary: Nekko, a Bengaluru-based startup, is shifting its focus from AI services to developing proprietary products. The company is building computer vision systems and agentic AI solutions to drive business process transformation. This strategic move aims to create a new growth engine for the company.

AI Start-Up News.title: Lightspeed leads $7 Mn Series A round in SuperLiving
AI Start-Up News.summary: SuperLiving, a wellness and preventive healthcare platform, has raised $7 million in a Series A funding round led by Lightspeed, with participation from existing investors Kae Capital and All In Capital. This funding round follows a previous $2 million raise five months ago, and a Rs 2 crore investment from All In Capital in September 2025. The new funds will be used to enhance AI capabilities and expand vernacular content offerings.

AI Start-Up News.title: MoEngage acquires AI startup Aampe to boost personalised marketing
AI Start-Up News.summary: MoEngage has acquired AI startup Aampe to enhance its personalised marketing capabilities. The acquisition aims to leverage Aampe's AI technology to provide more targeted and effective marketing solutions. This move is expected to boost MoEngage's ability to deliver tailored customer experiences.

AI Start-Up News.title: How This Bengaluru Startup Is Tackling Enterprise Finance’s Costly Blindspot
AI Start-Up News.summary: A Bengaluru startup is addressing a costly blindspot in enterprise finance by automating financial reconciliation, a critical function that remains largely manual despite advances in AI. Financial reconciliation is a crucial process that involves verifying the accuracy of financial transactions and accounts. The startup aims to tackle this inefficiency and reduce costs for corporations.

AI Start-Up News.title: Exclusive: EMO Energy's valuation jumps 4.3X to Rs 860 Cr in pre-Series B round
AI Start-Up News.summary: EMO Energy, a Bengaluru-based energy-tech startup, has raised Rs 59 crore ($6.2 million) in a pre-Series B funding round led by Raghav Capital. The company's valuation has jumped 4.3 times to Rs 860 crore as a result of this funding round. EMO Energy had previously secured $6.2 million in a Series A round led by Subhkam Ventures in January last year.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bengaluru ranks second in Asia for AI Innovation
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bengaluru has ranked second in Asia for AI-native startups, solidifying its position as a global startup and AI hub. The city has also entered the global top 10 for performance and R&D, according to the Global Startup Ecosystem Report 2026. Bengaluru's ranking reflects its growing strength in the AI innovation sector.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bengaluru ranked second-best AI-native cluster in Asia, top 15th startup ecosystem globally
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bengaluru has been ranked the second-best AI-native cluster in Asia and 15th in the global startup ecosystem. The city scored high in performance and R&D with a score of 9 out of 10. Bengaluru received scores of 8 in AI-native cluster and 7 in funding and market-reach.

AI Start-Up News.title: Used two-wheeler platform Speedioo raises seed funding led by Atomic Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Speedioo, a Pune-based used two-wheeler startup, has raised Rs 10 crore in seed funding led by Atomic Capital. The funds will be used to build its AI-native technology stack, expand distribution, and strengthen partnerships. Founded by former CredR and Rentomojo executives, Speedioo aims to improve transparency and customer experience in the used two-wheeler market through AI integration.

AI Start-Up News.title: Rekise Marine raises $9.7 Mn seed round led by Accel and NKSquared
AI Start-Up News.summary: Rekise Marine, a marine robotics startup, has raised $9.7 million in a seed funding round co-led by Accel and NKSquared. The funding round also saw participation from existing investors and new ones, including Industrial47 and several family offices. The proceeds will be used to develop the company's autonomous underwater vehicle, Jalkapi, and expand its engineering team.

AI Start-Up News.title: Sports-tech startup Dartle raises $100K in seed funding led by IPV
AI Start-Up News.summary: Kerala-based sports-tech startup Dartle has raised $100,000 in seed funding led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand its market presence, particularly in the US, and enhance its AI integrations. Dartle operates a B2B SaaS platform for youth sports and football academies, currently serving 14 academies across India and the Middle East.

AI Start-Up News.title: Peak XV leads Rs 72 Cr round in quick commerce platform BazaarNow
AI Start-Up News.summary: BazaarNow, a quick commerce platform, has raised Rs 72 crore ($7.8 million) in a funding round led by Peak XV Partners, with participation from other investors. The company has now raised a total of Rs 80 crore to date, including its pre-seed round. The funding round also saw participation from angel investors, including notable figures such as Vidit Aatrey and Karthik Gurumurthy.

AI Start-Up News.title: The Bengaluru startup using AI to bring precision to brain and mental health care
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bengaluru-based BrainSightAI is using AI to improve brain and mental health care by combining neuroimaging, personalized brain mapping, and clinical decision-support tools. This technology helps doctors better diagnose and treat neurological and mental health conditions. BrainSightAI will be showcased by the Ministry of Education at Bharat Innovat.

AI Start-Up News.title: BEENEXT leads Rs 30 Cr pre-seed round in edtech startup ProLearn
AI Start-Up News.summary: Edtech startup ProLearn has raised Rs 30 crore ($3.2 million) in a pre-seed funding round led by BEENEXT, with participation from other investors. The funds will be used to accelerate product development, enhance AI infrastructure, and expand curriculum-aligned content. ProLearn is an AI-native edtech startup that offers personalized learning solutions for K-12 students and competitive exam aspirants.

AI Start-Up News.title: Your cleaner may be recording you: Bengaluru startup’s head-mounted cameras trigger AI privacy storm
AI Start-Up News.summary: A Bengaluru startup has developed head-mounted cameras for cleaners, sparking concerns over AI privacy. These cameras can potentially record and collect data on individuals, raising questions about data protection and surveillance. The use of such devices has triggered a debate about the balance between innovation and personal privacy.

AI Start-Up News.title: Recovery-tech platform Owners ID raises pre-seed round led by Crucifer Investments
AI Start-Up News.summary: Recovery-tech startup Owners ID has raised $260K in a pre-seed funding round led by Crucifer Investments. The funds will be used for product development, technology enhancement, and global market expansion. Owners ID aims to create a digital identity layer for physical belongings using QR technology, making lost valuables easily returnable.

AI Start-Up News.title: Meet LiteFold, a biotech startup using proprietary AI to speed up drug discovery
AI Start-Up News.summary: LiteFold is a biotech startup utilizing proprietary AI to expedite drug discovery. The company is based in Bengaluru and Delaware, operating as an AI-native platform. It aims to accelerate computational biology workflows through its innovative technology.

AI Start-Up News.title: Telephony infra startup Vobiz.ai raises $1 Mn led by Piper Serica
AI Start-Up News.summary: Vobiz.ai, an API-driven telephony infrastructure platform, has raised $1 million in a seed funding round led by Piper Serica VC Fund. The funds will be used to strengthen the company's engineering and go-to-market capabilities. Vobiz.ai provides low-latency, secure voice infrastructure for AI voice agents and applications, addressing the limitations of traditional telephony in the era of conversational AI.

AI Start-Up News.title: Credit lifecycle platform Oolka raises $14 Mn in Series A led by Accel
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bengaluru-based fintech startup Oolka has raised $14 million in a Series A funding round led by Accel, with participation from existing investors Lightspeed and Z47. The funding round values Oolka at around Rs 730 crore ($87.6 million) post-money. Oolka had previously raised an undisclosed amount, with this new round increasing its valuation significantly.

AI Start-Up News.title: Deep-tech startup Ctruh secures $2.5 Mn in seed funding
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deep-tech startup Ctruh has secured $2.5 million in seed funding from investors including Inflection Point Ventures and Avinya Ventures. This funding round follows a previous $2 million investment in January 2023, bringing the total investment to $4.5 million. The funds will be used for research, product innovation, and international expansion.

AI Start-Up News.title: Capital-A announces first close of Rs 160 Cr for Fund II
AI Start-Up News.summary: Capital-A, an early-stage venture capital firm, has secured the first close of its second fund at Rs 160 crore to back startups in sectors like aerospace and energy transition. The fund is targeting a base corpus of Rs 300 crore with a greenshoe option of Rs 100 crore. The first close was largely anchored by indigenous investors, including several family offices and individual investors.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI-powered R&D platform for consumer products; Demand for AI talent spikes in India
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deeptech startup Bettrlabs is using AI to digitize product development for consumer brands, streamlining the process from idea to formulation. The demand for AI talent in India is increasing, with Bengaluru leading in AI hiring, followed by Hyderabad. Tier II cities are also emerging as hubs for AI talent in the country.

AI Start-Up News.title: Exclusive: Oolka raises Rs 130 Cr in Series A led by Accel at Rs 730 Cr valuation
AI Start-Up News.summary: Fintech startup Oolka has raised Rs 130 crore in a Series A funding round led by Accel India, valuing the company at Rs 730 crore. Accel India invested Rs 87.22 crore, while existing investors Lightspeed and Z47 infused Rs 20.87 crore and Rs 20.86 crore, respectively. The funding round was completed through the allotment of equity shares and compulsorily convertible preference shares.

AI Start-Up News.title: Textile tech startup STCH raises $5.5M in pre-Series A round led by Omnivore
AI Start-Up News.summary: STCH, a textile tech startup, has raised $5.5 million in a pre-Series A funding round led by Omnivore. The company will utilize the capital to enhance its AI capabilities and research and development. The funds will also be used to strengthen partnerships with textile mills and global fashion brands.

AI Start-Up News.title: Emergent launches VibeCon India, offers direct YC interview to winning team
AI Start-Up News.summary: Emergent is hosting VibeCon India, a selection-led hackathon, on April 16-17 in Bengaluru, where the winning team will receive a direct interview with a Y Combinator partner. The event precedes Y Combinator's Startup School India on April 18, creating a week focused on building and testing new ideas. The hackathon aims to bring together founders, engineers, and operators to prioritize exceptional builders and tangible outcomes.

AI Start-Up News.title: DAAKit raises $138K in pre-seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: DAAKit, a hyperlocal fulfillment and last-mile logistics startup, has raised $138K in a pre-seed funding round led by Inflection Point Ventures. The funds will be used to expand operations, launch new dark stores, and strengthen its technology infrastructure and team. DAAKit was founded in 2024 and operates an asset-light logistics model, currently serving cities including Delhi, Gurugram, and Mumbai.

AI Start-Up News.title: How two Bengaluru brothers are building a GitHub alternative for the AI age from Finland
AI Start-Up News.summary: Tangled, a company founded by brothers Akshay and Anirudh Oppiliappan, is developing a GitHub alternative tailored for the AI era. The platform aims to facilitate collaboration among developers in a future where AI agents will play a significant role in writing and reviewing code. The company is based in Finland and is reimagining developer collaboration for this new landscape.

AI Start-Up News.title: H2LooP raises $2 Mn in seed round from Speciale Invest and 3one4 Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Deeptech startup H2LooP has raised $2 million in a seed funding round co-led by Speciale Invest and 3one4 Capital. The funds will be used to expand into high-complexity sectors such as data centres, UAVs, and robotics. H2LooP is a deeptech startup focused on AI-driven development tools for embedded systems, hardware engineering, and software that powers hardware.

AI Start-Up News.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 30 - Apr 4]
AI Start-Up News.summary: Indian startups raised around $100 million in funding this week, with 21 startups securing investments across 4 growth-stage, 13 early-stage, and 4 undisclosed deals. This amount is lower than the $286.54 million raised by 31 startups in the previous week. The funding landscape saw a decline in investment compared to the previous week.

AI Start-Up News.title: Flipkart-backed NeuroPixel.AI shuts operations amid financial strain
AI Start-Up News.summary: NeuroPixel.AI, a Bengaluru-based AI startup, has shut down its operations after six years due to limited business penetration and rising competition. The startup, which developed AI-led solutions for the fashion ecommerce sector, cited the launch of advanced image generation models by global companies as a key factor in intensifying competition. Founded in 2020, NeuroPixel.AI was backed by Flipkart, but ultimately succumbed to financial strain.

AI Start-Up News.title: Exclusive: Gnani.ai kicks off Series B round led by Aavishkaar Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: Gnani.ai, a voice-first generative AI firm, has raised Rs 68 crore ($7.17 million) in a Series B funding round led by Aavishkaar Capital. The company's valuation has increased to Rs 818 crore ($87 million) in this round, up from Rs 204 crore in its previous round. The funding will be utilized through the allotment of 1,647 compulsory convertible preference shares.

AI Start-Up News.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startup this week [Mar 23 - Mar 28]
AI Start-Up News.summary: 30 Indian startups raised around $286.52 million in funding this week, with 7 growth-stage, 17 early-stage, and 6 undisclosed deals. This amount is nearly equal to the $286.54 million secured by 26 startups in the previous week. The funding landscape remains steady, with a consistent flow of investments in Indian startups.

AI Start-Up News.title: Tech startup Aerchain raises $13M in Series A round led by Pavestone VC
AI Start-Up News.summary: Aerchain, a Bengaluru-based tech startup, has raised $13M in a Series A funding round led by Pavestone VC. The startup plans to utilize the funding to expand its market presence and enhance its AI capabilities. The funding will support Aerchain's growth in the procurement segment.

AI Start-Up News.title: Prashant Pitti’s Optimo Capital raises Rs 100 Cr from PNB
AI Start-Up News.summary: Optimo Capital, a tech-led NBFC, has raised Rs 100 crore in debt funding from Punjab National Bank and partnered with Godrej Finance to co-lend Rs 200 crore over 12 months. This development comes six months after the company secured Rs 150 crore in equity funding led by Blume Ventures and Omnivore. Optimo Capital focuses on MSME lending, offering digital secured loan-against-property products to borrowers with limited access to formal credit.

AI Start-Up News.title: Peak XV alumni to launch Ambition Capital targeting $250 Mn early-stage fund: Report
AI Start-Up News.summary: Former Peak XV Partners executives are launching Ambition Capital, a new venture capital firm aiming to raise $250 million for early-stage investments. The fund is being set up by Shailesh Lakhani, Harshjit Sethi, and Mayank Porwal, all former Peak XV associates. Ambition Capital, based in Bengaluru, plans to invest in seed and Series A rounds.

AI Start-Up News.title: Karnataka budget: Pressing AI accelerator to boost farming, education & more
AI Start-Up News.summary: Karnataka's budget aims to leverage artificial intelligence to enhance various sectors, including farming and education. The state plans to utilize AI to drive growth and improvement in these areas. The initiative is part of a broader effort to accelerate digital transformation and boost development in the region.

AI Start-Up News.title: Peak XV leads $2.5 Mn round in Companion Labs
AI Start-Up News.summary: Companion Labs, a consumer AI company, has raised $2.5 million in a seed funding round led by Peak XV's Surge, with participation from other investors. The company aims to build interactive experiences for India's vernacular and culturally diverse audiences. The funding will be used to accelerate product development.

AI Start-Up News.title: Deep-tech robotics startup Armatrix raises $2.1 Mn led by pi Ventures
AI Start-Up News.summary: Armatrix, a deep-tech robotics startup, has raised $2.1 million in a pre-seed funding round led by pi Ventures. The funding will be used to develop its proprietary snake-like flexible robotic arm technology and expand its engineering and R&D team. The company plans to accelerate pilot deployments with industrial customers using the raised capital.

AI Start-Up News.title: HireBound raises $2 Mn in seed round led by Kalaari Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: HireBound, an AI-powered recruitment platform, has raised $2 million in a seed funding round led by Kalaari Capital, with participation from Antler, Infinyte Club, and CareerNet. The Bengaluru-based startup plans to use the funds to strengthen product development, expand operations, and scale globally. HireBound aims to achieve a 5x increase in annual recurring revenue (ARR) over the next 12-18 months.

AI Start-Up News.title: India's AI ambitions: Homegrown tech at New Delhi Summit aims for global impact
AI Start-Up News.summary: India's AI ambitions were on display at a New Delhi summit, where homegrown tech companies showcased their innovations. Indian companies, including Bengaluru-based Gnani.ai, debuted new products, such as speech models, highlighting the country's potential to become a global AI power. The summit demonstrated India's growing presence in the AI sector, with companies aiming for global impact.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bharat1.AI to establish first-ever ‘humanity centric AI City’ in Bengaluru
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bharat1.AI is set to establish the first-ever "humanity centric AI City" in Bengaluru. This initiative aims to create a unique hub focused on artificial intelligence. The project's details and launch timeline have not been specified in the available information.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI consulting startup Navikenz raises $11.6 Mn led by Sekar PRC and Sudip Nandy
AI Start-Up News.summary: Navikenz, an AI consulting startup, has raised $11.6 million in a funding round co-led by Sekar PRC and Sudip Nandy. The Noida-based company had previously secured $8 million in funding, and this new investment will be used to expand its team and technology. Navikenz aims to help enterprises adopt AI-driven solutions to enhance business processes and drive digital transformation.

AI Start-Up News.title: CraftifAI secures $3 Mn in seed round led by Ankur Capital
AI Start-Up News.summary: CraftifAI, a multi-agent GenAI-powered platform, has raised $3 million in a seed funding round led by Ankur Capital, with participation from other investors. The funds will be used to scale hiring and expand its global market presence. CraftifAI was co-founded in 2025 by Pratik Sharda and Yashwant Dagar, and focuses on Generative AI-powered platforms for embedded systems, IoT, and Edge AI applications.

AI Start-Up News.title: Semiconductor startup C2i Semiconductors raises $15 Mn led by Peak XV
AI Start-Up News.summary: C2i Semiconductors, a Bengaluru-based startup, has raised $15 million in funding led by Peak XV Partners, with participation from Yali Deeptech and TDK Ventures. The company had previously raised $4 million from Yali Capital in November 2024. The new funding will support global expansion, including setting up a US office and building a team in Taiwan.

AI Start-Up News.title: Sarvam AI outperforms Google Gemini and ChatGPT on India-specific AI tasks
AI Start-Up News.summary: Sarvam AI's new models, Sarvam Vision and Bulbul V3, have outperformed industry giants like Google Gemini and ChatGPT on India-specific AI tasks. The Bengaluru-based company is making a significant impact in the global AI scene with its innovative models. Sarvam AI's achievement surpasses that of major players like Google and OpenAI.

AI Start-Up News.title: Loop AI raises $14 M in Series A round led by Nyca Partners
AI Start-Up News.summary: Loop AI has raised $14 million in a Series A funding round led by Nyca Partners. The company's AI platform is designed to support back-office operations for restaurants and retail businesses. The new funding will be used to expand product offerings and increase staff across its global offices.

AI Start-Up News.title: Swiggy lets users order through ChatGPT, Claude
AI Start-Up News.summary: Swiggy is integrating its services with AI assistants like ChatGPT, allowing users to order meals, groceries, and book tables directly through these platforms. This move expands commerce beyond traditional app interfaces, enhancing user convenience. The integration includes other AI assistants like Claude and Gemini.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI-powered assistive eyewear for the visually impaired launched in Bengaluru
AI Start-Up News.summary: AI-powered assistive eyewear has been launched in Bengaluru to aid the visually impaired. This innovative technology is designed to provide assistance and support to individuals with visual impairments. The launch of this eyewear marks a significant development in assistive technology, aiming to improve the daily lives of the visually impaired.

AI Start-Up News.title: Bengaluru Voice AI Startup Bolna Grabs $6.3 Mn to Enhance Vernacular Calls
AI Start-Up News.summary: Bolna, a Bengaluru-based voice AI startup, has secured $6.3 million in funding to enhance its vernacular call capabilities. The company's platform enables businesses to run voice AI systems in multiple languages and scenarios. This investment will likely support Bolna's efforts to expand its voice AI offerings.

AI Start-Up News.title: Dunzo co-founder’s vibe-coding startup Emergent raises $70M from Khosla Ventures, SoftBank Vision Fund 2
AI Start-Up News.summary: Emergent, a startup co-founded by Dunzo co-founder Mukund Jha and his twin brother Madhav Jha, has raised $70M from investors including Khosla Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund 2. The company offers an AI-native platform that enables users to create web and mobile applications using natural language, eliminating the need for coding. This innovative platform allows for production-ready applications to be built without requiring users to write code.
